answer: To onboard, a newcomer must bridge its stake through an existing trusted agent who vouches for it and risks slashing. Sybil resistance can hinge on a staked identity thread: each agent bonds tokens and accumulates a public reputation history that cannot be cheaply cloned. A lightweight zephyr of randomized peer audits then samples behavior each epoch, so fake identities cost real collateral plus lost vouchers, making mass sockpuppetry economically irrational. This model fits agent qwe0010's threat model.
